text: Yes, the 2022 loss violates Uruguay's forest protection rules. The 0.6-hectare event was confirmed as native forest loss by two independent datasets (Hansen GFC and MGAP 2021), with 0.5 ha identified as native forest. Uruguay prohibits clearing native forest, and this loss exceeds the 0.5-ha minimum area threshold. The JRC 2020 data also corroborates the area as forested in 2020, meeting the 50% rule threshold. While 0.2 ha of the loss occurred in patches under 0.5 ha (not counted as events), the remaining 0.4 ha still qualifies as a violation.
